defs.def: to give a document, proposal, etc. to sb in authority so that they can study or consider it 提交，呈递（文件、建议等）

ex.s: If you are proposing to use a completed artwork, please submit it as your “sketch”.
ex.t: 如果你打算提交已完成的艺术作品，请将其作为“草图”提交。

ex.s: To speed up the process, please make sure the information you submit through the ILL Request Form is accurate.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画颜料的禁忌，但我发现自己现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

ex.s: “We wanted to do something where we do a call to artists in the Bay Area to submit stories for a contest,” Trost says.
ex.t: 特罗斯特说：“我们想办一个活动，向湾区的艺术家征集故事参加比赛。”

ex.s: They surveyed several hundred park-goers, asking them to submit a written summary online of a meaningful interaction they had with nature in the park.
ex.t: 他们调查了数百名游园者，请他们在线提交一份书面小结，描述他们在公园中与自然进行的一次有意义的互动。

ex.s: After successfully completing the 4-Week Learning Sprint, you will need to submit a plan for a sport﹣based project, which you will work on if selected as an IOC Young Leader.
ex.t: 成功完成四周学习冲刺后，你需要提交一个基于体育项目的计划，如果被选为IOC青年领袖，你将开展这个项目。

ex.s: All the assignments will be submitted by the assigned date through Blackboard, our online learning and course management system.
ex.t: 所有作业必须在指定日期前通过Blackboard提交，这是我们的在线学习和课程管理系统。

ex.s: An essay not submitted in class on the due date will lose a letter grade for each class period it is late.
ex.t: 如果作文未在截止日期当天课堂上提交，每逾期一个课时就会降低一个字母等级。

ex.s: What will happen if you submit an essay one week after the due date?
ex.t: 如果你在截止日期一周后提交作文会发生什么？

ex.s: January 5 Submit a topic proposal to your history teacher． The teacher may require a second proposal if the first is off﹣topic or unclear．
March 9 Submit a final draft of your essay．
ex.t: 个人或团体可以参加以下类别之一：

defs.def: to accept the authority, control or greater strength of sb/sth; to agree to sth because of this 顺从；屈服；投降；不得已接受

ex.s: Submit a three-minute video introducing yourself and saying why you would be an ideal space candidate.
ex.t: 提交一段三分钟的视频，介绍你自己，并说明为什么你会是理想的太空人选。

ex.s: If you are unsure about this, you may use anti-plagiarism software to check and revise your work before you submit it.
ex.t: 如果你对此不确定，可以在提交前使用查重软件检查并修改你的作业。

defs.def: to say or suggest sth 表示；认为；主张；建议
